It is decided in the editor get/set helpers and in the parsers' rightWhitespaceCount.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names a UI page script (1p-filters.js currentStateChanged), so a solver can argue the engine parser and the argument parser are a separate component that only sees per-line, list-maintainer content, not the editor's whole-document text.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
rightWhitespaceCount must still return exactly the trailing-whitespace length: it sets argument/line end offsets and emits NODE_TYPE_WHITESPACE nodes for editor highlighting and trimming. A pattern that consumes the preceding non-space char without a capture group (match[0]) is off by one. Over-broad fixes (stripping all whitespace, length caps) would break hosts-file lines and inline ' # comment' handling, and the editor's trailing '

'/'
' normalisation.
